before.description: Blank practice profile ownership resolves exactly one canonical blank_practice_session via final_check_bound_practice, then authenticates it inside the protected transaction. Migration-owned fixed-path routines read existing control_plane.blank_practice_session, contractor_practice_session, practice_company_marker and app.membership/job/firm_profile only; no new table grants. job_saved_firm_name is runtime EXECUTE only and calls final_check_job_scope for exact job ownership. Reapplication is data preserving; forward fix replaces routines in a later migration without deleting or transferring stored profiles. Existing current_firm_profile_key owner/ACL and all RLS policies remain. No profile, document, hash, outbox, approval or acceptance rows are rewritten. Reapplication is data preserving; forward fix replaces routines in a later migration without deleting or transferring stored profiles. A SELECT-only firm_profile_bound_reader policy gives the FORCE-RLS definer owner the existing bound firm_profile_access predicate; no write policy or table grant is added. 0764 resolves a saved name in both invoice writers after their existing actor/job/practice checks and replay returns, and only when a protected blank-firm profile key is present; one resolved value enters artifact text before hashing and issuer.legalName.
